revenue_scope: OLPRUVA net revenue as Zevra prints it: a product-named amount in the earnings-release 'Revenue, Net' bullet and in the revenue-recognition note 'sales of OLPRUVA', stated in millions to one decimal place
geography: Not stated in the revenue amounts. Zevra's text says OLPRUVA is available in the U.S. and that Relief holds European rights (no European sales are reported)
moa: Nitrogen-binding agent: sodium phenylbutyrate is a prodrug of phenylacetate, which conjugates with glutamine to form phenylacetylglutamine that is excreted in urine, lowering blood ammonia

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 214860 NDA APPROVAL Acer Therapeutics Inc. ... for Olpruva (sodium phenylbutyrate) for oral suspension ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling. (Drugs@FDA lists the original approval as 2022-12-22; Zevra's documents give December 27, 2022.)

launch_evidence.quote: The full commercial launch of OLPRUVA was initiated at the end of January 2024

series_start_reason: Zevra prints a numeric OLPRUVA amount only from the fourth quarter of 2024. Acer (the issuer before the Zevra merger closed November 17, 2023) booked 'Product revenue, net' of 371,790 US dollars (statement of operations with no thousands or millions scale, so US dollars) in the quarter ended September 30, 2023 (Acer 10-Q filed 2023-11-20); Zevra's fourth-quarter 2023 release says only 'some initial sales of OLPRUVA' and its first-, second- and third-quarter 2024 releases and 10-Qs say OLPRUVA revenue was 'de minimis'. Those quarters carry no figure, so the series starts at the first quarter after them to leave no gap; the Acer figure is not spliced in.
notes: All figures are printed to one decimal place in USD millions, so every row is rounded to $0.1 million; quarterly values are therefore coarse. 2025 quarters 0.1 + 0.3 + 0.1 + 0.4 add to 0.9 against the printed full-year 0.8 (the 10-K and the fourth-quarter 2025 release), a rounding difference of 0.1. The 2024 full-year figure printed in the FY2025 10-K is $0.1 million, equal to the single 2024Q4 amount. 2024Q4 and 2025Q4 rows quote the earnings release bullet 'Revenue, Net' because the OLPRUVA amount follows the MIPLYFFA amount in that sentence; the other rows quote the 10-Q note 'sales of OLPRUVA'. The brand first sold in July 2023 per Zevra's Q1 2025 release ('initial product availability in July 2023'). Scale-back: Zevra's 2026 10-Qs say it decided to scale back sales and marketing efforts for OLPRUVA. The series runs to 2026Q2, Zevra's second-quarter 2026 10-Q filed 2026-08-05, the latest quarter published.
